signals.text: 2 open PM roles across 1 US office
1 new PM role posted this week

news.title: Spotify launches brand to sell its software tools to other companies
Spotify launches Spotify Technology to sell its internal software tools to other companies, says the brand is ‘becoming the R&D operating system’
Spotify launches smart playlists to soundtrack your runs

bullets: Shape and execute product strategy across core book experiences, conversion flows, content pipeline, and creator tooling.
Partner with teams across Spotify to identify and close gaps across book surfaces, creating a coherent end-to-end experience from content pipeline through to the consumer…
Collaborate with Design, Engineering, Product Insights, and Program Management to lead improvements across discovery, conversion, listening, and creator-facing surfaces.
Conduct, commission, and use research to understand listener behavior, creator needs, book consumption patterns, and market trends.
Use qualitative and quantitative insights to identify the most impactful opportunities across the book ecosystem and prioritize accordingly.

roles.title: Head of Product Management - Artist Products

bullets: Set the strategy and direction for Spotify’s artist and label products, connecting artist tools, promotion, discovery, expression, and insights into a coherent product experience.
Own business and product outcomes across the portfolio, translating long-term strategy into clear priorities and near-term goals.
Lead, coach, and develop PM managers and senior PMs, creating an environment where people can do their best work and continue strengthening their product craft.
Advance how the product organization uses AI to improve the way we build, learn, make decisions, and deliver value.
Make thoughtful prioritization and resource decisions across product areas, navigating trade-offs and keeping teams focused on the outcomes that matter most.
